name: Character.AI
ontology_notes: Official product memory: Pinned Memories / Story Memory (pin messages, 5 free, 2x on c.ai+), Chat Memories (up to 400 characters of fixed text, 2025 blog), Facts tabs for Persona / Character / side characters (c.ai+, auto-capture plus manual add/edit/disable). Memory Usage bar. Lorebook mentioned as upcoming. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.

ontology.evidence: Help/blog name pins, story memory, facts (persona/character/side), chat memories. Facts are the closest to typed entities. No public relationship_state type. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: User pins. User writes Chat Memories. Facts auto-captured and user-editable (c.ai+). Background 'tidies older context'. Extractor internals INCONCLUSIVE.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Pins and written Story Memory are protected as Memory fills. Help: limited conversation context so characters forget if not recent (2024 article). 2026 blog: cannot guarantee the Character uses written memory exactly. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Unpin, disable/remove Facts, overwrite Chat Memories. Copy Facts to a new chat is optional. How auto-facts conflict is unpublished. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
supersession.label: inferred

temporal.evidence: No public dated query. Memory Usage implies a budget that fills over a long chat. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
temporal.label: guess

identity_split.evidence: Facts tabs split Persona, Character, and side characters. Pins are per chat. New chat can copy or start fresh. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Disable a Fact, unpin, start fresh chat. No documented spoiler/trauma suppressor. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
silence.label: inferred

poisoning.evidence: Auto-captured Facts could store jokes as character canon. No public trust tags. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
poisoning.label: guess

forgetting.evidence: Unpin, remove Facts, do not copy Facts to new chat. Help still warns characters forget when context is exceeded. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Public limits: 5 pins (10 on plus), 400-character Chat Memories. Memory Usage visualization. Per-turn extract cost unpublished. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Closed hosted app. No self-host of Character.AI memory.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: No official MCP server in help/blog reviewed.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Pinned backstory plus auto facts is the hosted version of ST's always-on note plus extract. The vendor says they cannot guarantee the character uses it. No public typed relationship state. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
open_unknowns: Whether Lorebook has shipped since the May 2026 blog 'soon' note.
